description: Ministry of Defence - Awarding the Videsha Seva Padakkama to the Air Force Personnel
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the award of the Videsha Sewa Padakkama to specific named Air Force personnel (including rank and service number). It involves government personnel changes (awards to military personnel) and names specific individuals (GP Capt RP Liyanagamage), but does not include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2) as it focuses solely on personnel recognition without detailing their specific duties or responsibilities.
